caption:
The lounge suit was on sale decades before anyone credited a prince with it.

Cathcart London's journal finds Samuels Brothers advertising "seaside and country lounging suits" in 1853. The matching cloth set it apart, and the suit was colloquially called "dittos". Flannel lounge suits outnumbered frock and morning coats in the West End by 1905.

Connected to the sack suit, the morning coat, the frock coat and Edward VII.
